ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Retailer acquisition, Line sheet sent and later stages need Line sheet sent and Buying season.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Retailer_acquisition", CASE(StageName, "Identified", 1, "Contacted", 2, "Line sheet sent", 3, "Range review", 4, "Terms discussion", 5, "Account setup", 6, "Account opened", 7, 0) >= 3, OR(NOT(Line_sheet_sent__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Buying_season__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Line sheet sent and Buying season before moving to Line sheet sent.
